reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.Ito.masterLp -- reading (locked before any Lean)

Paper notion: the Ito integral int_0^t Z_s dW_s as an element of L^2(Omega,F,P) (sec. 3/4: "true
L^2 martingales by the Ito isometry"), i.e. the L^2-limit of the simple integrals along an
energy-approximating sequence of simple predictable processes (see masterApprox). Faithful Lean:
an element of Lp R 2 P (an a.e.-class), defined as the limit in L^2 of the simple integrals of
the master approximation (Cauchy by the isometry), for each time t (or at time T); independent of
the chosen sequence. Junk (e.g. 0, or a limit of a non-Cauchy sequence via limUnder) outside the
integrable class is harmless only if the propositions restrict to H^2 integrands. Not faithful:
limit in a weaker sense that does not give the L^2 limit, or a limit taken over integrands that
are not adapted to the Brownian filtration.

Paper context (sec. 2, sec. 3, sec. 4, App. A). Standing basis: (Omega,F,(F_t),P) satisfying the usual
conditions, horizon T>0, d-dimensional Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random
measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E,E);
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial
sigma-field F_0. Stochastic integrals int Z dW (Z in H^2_W: R^{m x d}-valued predictable,
E int_0^T |Z|_F^2 dt < oo) and int int U dNtilde (U in H^2_N) are the L^2 (Ito /
compensated-Poisson isometry) integrals; they are true L^2 martingales, cadlag, and are used in
identities holding a.s. for every t (sec. 3, "solution"). The paper never constructs these
integrals itself: it takes the standard construction (Applebaum sec. 4, He-Wang-Yan). So every
unit below is infrastructure: the paper's notion is the textbook one, and a faithful Lean
definition is one that (together with the other definitions) yields the textbook object on the
paper's basis for every integrand the paper's claims use; junk values outside that class are
harmless only if every proposition restricts to the class.

comparison.text:
Comparison: def:LevyStochCalc.Brownian.Ito.masterLp (ItoL2CompletionMaster.lean:205-212)

Reading: an Lp R 2 P element, the L^2-limit ingredient: the simple integral of the n-th master
approximant at time t, lifted to L^2; limit taken over a Cauchy sequence; junk outside harmless.
Lean: masterLp t n := if 0 <= t /\ t <= n+1 then (MemLp of simpleIntegral W (masterApprox n) t,
using masterApprox_adapt and IsBrownianFiltration W F).toLp else 0. So for each fixed t >= 0 it is
eventually (n >= ceil t) the L^2 class of int_0^t G_n dW with G_n adapted simple; the sequence is
Cauchy (masterLp_cauchySeq) by the difference isometry. For t < 0 it is 0 for all n (the integral
up to a negative time is 0, consistent with the convention). The zero branch for t > n+1 affects
only finitely many n for each t, so it does not affect the limit. Matches.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Choices: (1) value 0 when t lies outside [0, n+1]: for t >= 0 this affects only the finitely many
n < t - 1, so the limit in n is unchanged; for t < 0 the value 0 is the integral up to a negative
time. (2) It is an a.e.-class (Lp R 2 P) of the simple integral, which is the object whose L^2
limit is the Ito integral; the representative is chosen later (stochasticIntegralBrownian).
